## What & why
Briefly describe the change and the motivation. Link the issue: `Closes #`.

## Type
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Chore / refactor

## Checklist
- [ ] Branched off `main` (`feat/…`, `fix/…`, `docs/…`, `chore/…`) — not committed to `main` directly
- [ ] Scoped to one concern; commits are focused
- [ ] Tested locally (the scan → analyze path for backend changes; the affected screen for frontend)
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env`, API keys stay out)
- [ ] For analyzer changes: severity stays **scored in code**, the LLM only explains — no scoring or inventing findings

## Notes for the reviewer
Anything to watch out for; screenshots for UI changes.
